note: Spalding Township park on US-2 by the Cedar River: rustic sites, large with a turnaround loop (firsthand reports of 30-36 ft rigs fitting). Pavilions, beach, ball fields, playground, walking trail; the park is also an ATV and snowmobile trailhead and hosts truck-pull competitions. --Claude
